name: pdfm-mcp
description: Inspect and control Parallels Desktop virtual machines: list, power, screenshot, run guest commands, type keys, and run multi-step sequences.

interface.shortDescription: Find, control and automate Parallels Desktop VMs
interface.longDescription: Lets Codex list VMs, start/stop/suspend them, take screenshots, read screen text, run commands inside the guest, send keyboard input and run multi-step automation sequences. Requires macOS, Parallels Desktop and the pdfm-mcp binary on your PATH (brew install --cask Parallels/tap/pdfm-mcp).
